CLAIMED bd-hkw5.1 (coalition observability dashboard). Reserved: flywheel/src/{coalition,main}.rs (exclusive, 2h).

GATE: coalition status on the live coalition shows intents/TTL/frozen/negotiations; --json parses clean.

PLAN:
1. coalition.rs: deepen CoalitionStatus — intents carry TTL (expires_ts_us) + soft_conflicts (frozen paths) from member_intents; member_reservations already exist; add in-flight negotiations (pending request-release ladder); run state already in CoalitionStatus.run.
2. Rich JSON: CoalitionStatus gains ttl/frozen/negotiations fields (additive, serde default). Digest mode: flywheel coalition status --digest (human one-liner per member + intents + frozen).
3. Tests: hermetic — form coalition, declare intent with TTL, reserve conflicting path (freeze), negotiate request (pending), assert status JSON shows all.
4. GATE: live coalition status --json parses clean with intents/TTL/frozen/negotiations.

NOT touching: toron repo, cron.rs, stages.rs, intent.rs (other lanes).
